calculate_vit_lr_decay_rate: calculate the learning rate decay rate for a given ViT parameter name and layer configuration
get_param_groups_with_decay: get parameter groups with learning rate decay multipliers for a PyTorch model's named parameters
fuse_param_groups: fuse parameter groups by combining parameters that share the same lr_multiplier, wd_multiplier, and is_last_layer keys
get_param_groups_with_decay_fsdp: get parameter groups with learning rate decay for an FSDP-wrapped PyTorch model supporting SimpleFSDP and FSDP2
remove_fsdp_compile_names: remove FSDP, activation checkpointing, xFSDP, and torch.compile wrapper prefixes from a parameter name string
